title: Demo-script e2e remote mode against the deployed service (IMP-11)
story: As the sponsor I want the automated 10-minute demo to run against the deployed Cloud Run URL so that every sprint proves the live system, not just a local copy
acceptance: Without FNOL_BASE_URL the test behaves exactly as today (in-process app, real seed); node --test tests/e2e/demo-script.test.mjs passes

With FNOL_BASE_URL set, beats run over HTTPS against that URL: app tokens come from POST /api/v1/auth/token on the remote (devMode deployment), and when FNOL_IAP_TOKEN is set every request also sends Proxy-Authorization: Bearer <token> so IAP and the app's Authorization header do not collide
Remote mode never logs or prints FNOL_IAP_TOKEN, minted app tokens or response bodies containing PII; failures report status and beat name only

Remote mode does not mutate state it cannot restore: beat 4's config change is reverted in after() exactly as locally; beats that depend on in-process access are skipped in remote mode with a named reason
docs/demo-script.md gets a short 'Run against the deployed service' section (env vars, no secrets)
brief: PI-2 re-measure (org/scorecards/interventions.json): this ticket was diagnosed as context drift last time, so read the architecture hub and the S5-ARC-01 triage before you start. harness.mjs:115 mints tokens in-process; remote mode must use the HTTP token endpoint instead. You cannot reach the deployed service (the orchestrator runs remote mode with credentials); prove remote mode against a local server started on a port (createApp with port and devMode) using FNOL_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port>, in a test that is skipped unless FNOL_REMOTE_SELFTEST=1, and document how you ran it.
